'''''Begonia acutifolia''''', the '''holly-leaf begonia''', is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Begoniaceae]], native to [[Cuba]] and [[Jamaica]], and introduced to [[Saint Helena]].<ref name="317883-2" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:317883-2 |title=''Begonia acutifolia'' Jacq. |author=<!--Not stated--> |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=19 August 2021 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=''Begonia acutifolia'' Jacq. holly-leaf begonia |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/58567/i-Begonia-acutifolia-i-Jacq/Details |date=2021 |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=19 August 2021 }}</ref> Shade tolerant, it is kept as a house plant, or outside in [[Hardiness zone|USDA hardiness zone 9b]] or warmer.<ref>{{cite journal |title=Introgression of wild germplasm into cultivated ornamental plants |year=2019 |last1=Van Huylenbroeck |first1=J. |last2=Eeckhaut |first2=T. |last3=Leus |first3=L. |last4=Van Laere |first4=K. |last5=Dhooghe |first5=E. |journal=Acta Horticulturae |issue=1240 |pages=13–20 |doi=10.17660/ActaHortic.2019.1240.2 |s2cid=242387812 }}</ref>
